# UIPageLayout

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIPageLayout")`

Lays its parent's `UIObject` children side by side as pages and shows one (ADR 0128): a tutorial, a set of tabs, a carousel. The others are beside it, out of the parent's box -- turn `ClipsDescendants` on, or they show.

A page keeps its `Size` and loses its `Position`. `Next`, `Previous`, `JumpTo` and `JumpToIndex` turn the page, and so do a swipe, the wheel and a gamepad's shoulder buttons unless they are turned off. `CurrentPage` changes at once; the pages slide for `TweenTime` when `Animated`.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Animated` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a page turn slides. Off, the new page is there at once. |
| `Circular` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the page after the last is the first, and the one before the first the last. |
| `CurrentPage` | `UIObject?` | — | read-only | The page that is shown, or the one being slid to. Nothing when there are no pages. |
| `EasingDirection` | `Enum.EasingDirection` | `Enum.EasingDirection.Out` | read/write | Which end of the slide is eased. |
| `EasingStyle` | `Enum.EasingStyle` | `Enum.EasingStyle.Quad` | read/write | The shape of the slide. |
| `FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal` | read/write | Which way the pages run, and so which way they slide. |
| `GamepadInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a gamepad's shoulder buttons turn them. |
| `HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center` | read/write | Where the page that is shown sits across the parent. |
| `Padding` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The gap between pages. Scale is a fraction of the parent along the fill direction. |
| `ScrollWheelInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the wheel over the pages turns them. |
| `SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder` | read/write | What order the children go in. |
| `TouchInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a swipe across the pages turns them -- a finger's, or a mouse dragged. |
| `TweenTime` | `number` | `0.3` | read/write | How long a slide takes, in seconds. |
| `VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center` | read/write | Where it sits down the parent. |

## Methods

### `JumpTo(page: UIObject)`

Turns to `page`. An object that is not one of the pages is refused.

### `JumpToIndex(index: number)`

Turns to the page at `index`, counted from 0 in the layout's order. Past either end it stops at that end, or goes round when `Circular`.

### `Next()`

Turns to the page after `CurrentPage`. At the last page it does nothing, unless `Circular`.

### `Previous()`

Turns to the page before `CurrentPage`. At the first it does nothing, unless `Circular`.

## Events

Every signal here is **deferred** (ADR 0015): a handler runs at the next
drain point, never inside the call that fired it.

### `PageEnter(page: UIObject)`

`page` became `CurrentPage`: it is being turned to.

### `PageLeave(page: UIObject)`

`page` stopped being `CurrentPage`.

### `Stopped(page: UIObject)`

The slide ended with `page` shown. At once when the layout is not `Animated`.
